about.title: A calm, unhurried dental visit — right at Pathur Road Cross
paragraphs: Climb one flight of stairs at Perreddy Complex, near Reliance Digital, and you'll find Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic. It's a neighbourhood practice where Dr. Ramakanth sees every patient himself.
We believe a good dental visit starts with listening. You'll hear what we see, what your choices are and what each one costs — before a single instrument is picked up.
points: Every consultation with Dr. Ramakanth, MDS
